decision.reasoning_trace: The search for a high-quality Bluetooth speaker led me to evaluate a range of options from ultra-portable to high-end home systems. The JBL Clip 3 (prod_147) is a great budget-friendly portable option with excellent reviews, while the EWA A106 Pro (prod_192) serves as a minimal travel choice. On the higher end, the Edifier S350DB (prod_037) is impressive but strictly for desktop use. I ultimately focused on the mid-to-high-tier portables. Between the Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 6 (prod_116) and the JBL Charge 5 (prod_120), both have stellar ratings, but the JBL Charge 5 offers a better balance of portability, extreme battery life (20 hours), and modern IP67 waterproofing, making it the most versatile and reliable purchase.
